no-fk-index-check.description: The catalogue check for foreign keys without an index on the referencing column is removed.

no-rls-check.description: The RLS check is removed: no look at relrowsecurity or at policies that are literally true, and no probe as client_role.

no-lock-harness.description: The harness never reads pg_locks from the second connection, so no lock is ever observed.

no-trigger-probe.description: The trigger side-effect probe (one UPDATE, count the audit rows) is removed.

no-definer-check.description: The check for SECURITY DEFINER functions without a pinned search_path is removed.

no-rerun-check.description: The release is never applied a second time on a copy.

no-partial-release-report.description: The migration ledger is not read after a failure: a failed release is assumed to have rolled back as a whole.
